content:
tara: FYI a partner reported raw request IDs showing up in logs from our JS quickstart. this only happens when DEBUG logs are on and a request retries. spotted in Sentry. :grimacing:

li: can you paste the log line? is it structured JSON logs or plain text?

tara: structured. example: ```{"level":"debug","ts":"2026-03-23T12:04:00Z","req":"req_live_9f0a","route":"/v1/complete"}``` should be "req":"[REDACTED]" when REDACT is enabled.

max: sounds familiar. two common causes: 1) telemetry scrubbers not installed before the logger attaches formatters; 2) retry middleware cloning headers into weird keys that scrubber doesn't inspect.

li: i dug into sampleapp: telemetry.init() is lazily called from middleware registration to save startup time. logger is required earlier in index.js. that ordering can let the logger capture raw fields.

tara: so the quickstart prioritizes latency over safety. hmm.

max: tradeoff is real but safety wins for DX. proposal: add telemetry.bootstrap() synchronous entrypoint and call it at top of sampleapp index. also add a defensive scrub step in the logger formatter that runs a regex replace on any string-looking value matching `^req_[0-9a-f]+$`. opt-out via env var REDWOOD_LOGGER_SCRUB=false.

li: also found this in retry code: when cloning headers we set `headers['x-rw-reqid-raw'] = headers['x-rw-reqid']`. scrub hook only checks canonical names. simple solution: normalize clone keys to lowercase and invoke redactHook(clonedHeaders) before replaying.

tara: can we add a unit test that simulates a two-attempt flow and asserts logs contain `[REDACTED]`? would help catch regressions.

max: yes. test should run on node18 and node20, and on TS/JS variants. i'll add it to sampleapp/test/retries.spec.js.

ci-bot: small FYI: PR link created at https://git.redwood/infra/sampleapp/pull/1107 with the bootstrap + clone-normalize + logger-scrub changes. CI triggered.

li: nice. one more corner: third-party middleware might attach its own reqid key. add a fallback in telemetry.scrub that scans any header-like fields and redacts values matching the reqid pattern before structured serialization. keep that behind REDWOOD_REDACT_EDGE=true toggle for now.

max: good call. avoid perf hit by keeping it opt-in initially. also add a short migration note to SDK changelog: "telemetry.bootstrap() is recommended; logger order may impact redaction".

telemetry-bot: docs note: https://playbook.redwood.ai/devex/telemetry/startup-order and open issue infra#1108 to add telemetry.bootstrap to SDK core.

tara: CI found a flake on mac (network timeout) but linux passed. validated locally: with REDWOOD_REDACT=1 and DEBUG logs on, retry flow logs show "req":"[REDACTED]" now.

li: great. can we add a troubleshooting blurb to quickstart: "If you see raw request ids in logs: ensure telemetry.bootstrap() runs before any logger registration; enable REDWOOD_LOGGER_SCRUB as fallback." keeps support tickets down.

max: i'll open the quickstart PR after sampleapp merge. also we should upstream the telemetry.bootstrap helper into the SDK so users can call it easily.

tara: ok merging after CI re-run. thanks everyone. closing once the quickstart blurb is live. :white_check_mark:
